display_name: GraniteShares 2x Short SK Hynix Daily ETF bStock

about.en: GraniteShares 2x Short SK Hynix Daily ETF bStock (SKDDB) is a tokenized fund share of the GraniteShares 2x Short SK Hynix Daily ETF issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x515f386fc664980db2ab30c574ec210983232493, backed 1:1 by SKDD fund shares held with a regulated custodian and convertible 1:1 into the underlying fund share, so it inherits the daily-reset -2x exposure and roll costs of the ETF itself. bStocks are admitted to trading under prospectuses approved by the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority and are not offered in every jurisdiction.
